name: Cash Withdrawal Request 1
definition: Specifies the details of a cash withdrawal request.

CashReceiverReference.name: Cash Receiver Reference
CashReceiverReference.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the cash receiver for the cash withdrawal.

AmendmentIndicator.name: Amendment Indicator
AmendmentIndicator.definition: Indicates whether this message is amending an earlier request message.||Where the value Yes is indicated the OrderReference and CashReceiverReference must remain the same as the original message.||Where this element is not used the message is not considered an amendment.

RequestedValueDate.name: Requested Value Date
RequestedValueDate.definition: Date on which the cash receiver requests the cash to be withdrawn from the account.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account to which cash will be withdrawn.

CashWithdrawal.name: Cash Withdrawal
CashWithdrawal.definition: Provides the details of a cash withdrawal for an amount of money in cash notes and/or coins.

DeliveryMethod.name: Delivery Method
DeliveryMethod.definition: Specifies the delivery method for the cash withdrawal.

DeliveryAddress.name: Delivery Address
DeliveryAddress.definition: Specifies the address to which the cash withdrawal is delivered to.

WithdrawalContact.name: Withdrawal Contact
WithdrawalContact.definition: Party that is collecting the withdrawn cash.

SecureCarrierReference.name: Secure Carrier Reference
SecureCarrierReference.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the secure carrier for the withdrawal.

InsuranceIndicator.name: Insurance Indicator
InsuranceIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the withdrawal in transit is insured.||Where this element is not used the withdrawal is not insured.

WithdrawalAddress.name: Withdrawal Address
WithdrawalAddress.definition: Specifies the address where the cash withdrawal is sent from.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further details of the cash withdrawal.
